Class GameSettings

java.lang.Object
chess.gui.GameSettings
public final class GameSettings extends Object
The choices made in the new-game dialog: player names, and whether one side is played by the computer (and how well). Immutable.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameSettings

      private GameSettings(String whiteName, String blackName, PieceColor computerColor, Difficulty difficulty)
      Creates settings. Prefer the twoPlayer(String, String) and vsComputer(String, PieceColor, Difficulty) factories.
      Parameters:
      whiteName - white player's name, or null/blank for the default
      blackName - black player's name, or null/blank for the default
      computerColor - color the computer plays, or null for none
      difficulty - computer difficulty; must not be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a name fails checkName(String)
